item.text: CodeGraph emits value-reference edges to make impact analysis see the symbols that read file-scope constants, config objects, and lookup tables, since calls/imports/inheritance alone miss that change-impact path and can undercount the affected set. It keeps them precise by adding same-file `references` edges with `metadata.valueRef: true` from reader symbols to file-scope `const`/`var` targets, deduping per reader-target pair, never creating nodes, and enforcing the documented precision guards and shadow-pruning rules from the value-ref validation records.
